## Games

### Niners Chemnitz stage dramatic comeback to defeat MHP RIESEN Ludwigsburg

*Played Saturday, 31 October 2026* *(updated with new sources)*

Niners Chemnitz came from behind to defeat MHP RIESEN Ludwigsburg 94:78 in a thrilling game. The Chemnitz team, led by coach Rodrigo Pastore, trailed 43:48 at halftime but staged a remarkable comeback in the second half. The team's performance was boosted by the contributions of several players, including Nighael Ceaser (19 points), Ben Burnham (16 points), Stef Smith (14 points), Cobe Williams (13 points), and Ryan Mikesell (12 points). Despite missing key players Phlan Fleming and Darion Atkins due to the foreign player limit and injury, respectively, the team showed resilience and determination. The win marked the eighth victory for Chemnitz in the 14th game of the season and their sixth win in the last eight games. The team's next game is against Ludwigsburg, which they had previously lost to, and they will be looking to build on this momentum.

### Bamberg Baskets Secure First Home Win of the Season

*Played Sunday, 01 November 2026*

Bamberg Baskets secured their first home win of the season with an 88:78 victory over Science City Jena on November 1. The game, played in front of 4,501 fans at the BROSE ARENA, saw the home team take the lead in the second quarter and maintain it throughout the game. Trevon Scott and Richard Balint led the scoring for Bamberg with 17 and 18 points respectively, while London Perrantes topped the scoring for Jena with 20 points. The win marked Bamberg's fourth victory of the season and Jena's fourth defeat on the road this season.

### Syntainics MBC cruise to 109-89 win over Hamburg Towers

*Played Sunday, 01 November 2026*

Syntainics MBC secured their fourth consecutive win in the easyCredit BBL with a 109-89 victory over Veolia Towers Hamburg. The win, which came on November 1st, marked the team's third straight win in Hamburg and their fourth in a row overall. Vladimir Jovanovic's team remains in third place in the standings after seven games. Spencer Reaves led the Wölfe with 25 points, while Jure Planinic added 22 points and 11 rebounds for his sixth double-double of the season. Collin Welp scored 10 points, including his 1000th in the easyCredit BBL, and DeLonnie Hunt set a personal season high with 9 assists. The Wölfe set new season highs for points, three-pointers, and assists in the game. Hamburg, meanwhile, struggled to contain the Wölfe's offense and was unable to mount a significant comeback, despite the efforts of Mathys Kangudia, who scored 22 points. The loss was Hamburg's first at home in the easyCredit BBL this season.

### Telekom Baskets Bonn stun ALBA Berlin 95:88 in crunchtime thriller

*Played Sunday, 01 November 2026*

Telekom Baskets Bonn won their fifth home game of the season, beating ALBA Berlin 95:88 in a highly contested match. The game was a close one, with both teams trading baskets and neither able to gain a significant lead. However, in the final quarter, Bonn's offense came alive, and they were able to pull away from Berlin. John-Michael Wright was the top scorer for Bonn, with 22 points, including five three-pointers. Jordan Ford and Brandon Angel led Berlin with 19 points each. The win marked Bonn's fifth consecutive home victory, and they will look to build on this momentum in their next game. The loss was ALBA Berlin's fourth in their last five games, and they will need to regroup and refocus for their next match against Hagen on November 6.

## European Cups

### Alba Berlin secure second place in DBBL with 70:52 win over halfit Lions

Alba Berlin's women's basketball team secured second place in the DBBL with a 70:52 win over the halfit Lions on Sunday evening. The game was played in front of 1,515 fans in the Sömmeringhalle, with Alba Berlin dominating the first two quarters, leading 10:3 and 29:11 at halftime. The Lions managed to close the gap in the third quarter, but Alba Berlin pulled away in the final quarter to secure the win. The team, led by captain Lena Gohlisch, will next face Panathinaikos Athens in the EuroCup on Wednesday, November 4th.

### Rostock Seawolves stun Bayern Munich 69:67 in BBL upset

The Rostock Seawolves pulled off a major upset in the easyCredit BBL, defeating the previously undefeated Bayern Munich 69:67 at home. The Seawolves, led by coach Przemyslaw Frasunkiewicz, won their fourth game of the season, and their seventh overall in the BBL. Bayern Munich, led by European champion Johannes Thiemann, had been on a high after a recent 73:103 win over Red Star Belgrade, but struggled to find their rhythm against the Seawolves. TJ Crockett led the Seawolves with a strong start, and Austin Wiley's late-game play helped the team stay ahead. In the end, it was Artur Konontsuk who sealed the win with a crucial basket 48 seconds before the final buzzer, securing the Seawolves' fourth victory of the season.
